[h1]QoL UI Extensions Mod[/h1]
[i]Improve your user interface with these quality-of-life features:[/i]
[list] [*][b]Manabar in Party Window:[/b] Adds a mana bar to the party UI. [*][b]Item Value in Tooltips:[/b] Displays item value directly in tooltips. [*][b]Tourism Value Added:[/b] Shows tourism value for relevant items. [*][b]Decay Added:[/b] Shows % of decay (100% is rotten). [/list]
[h2]Links[/h2] [list] [*][b]Source code:[/b] [url=https://github.com/Yuof/Elin-Mods]github.com/Yuof/Elin-Mods[/url] [*][b]Support me on Ko-fi:[/b] [url=https://ko-fi.com/Y0J3204HLO]ko-fi.com/Y0J3204HLO[/url] [/list]
